(2) Non-Load Bearing Wall
Felling of non-load bearing reinforced concrete wall separately from integral heavy cross
beams over the wall, by manual method of demolition, is quite uncommon and impractical.
The engineer should avoid the use of manual method for demolition if heayy reinforced
beams exist in a building structure.

For external non-load bearing brick wall constructed under heavy crass beams, it may be
necessary to demolish the brick wall first to avoid the danger of collapse of the brick wall
during the demolition of the heavy cross beams. The engineer should assess this possibility
in the design with consideratian of the panel width, height and thickness of the brick wall,
